entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A renowned planeswalker necromancer who teaches at Strixhaven under the name Professor Onyx and is a former student there.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: A bookish young planeswalker from Eldraine and Rowan's twin brother who comes to Strixhaven to learn.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A headstrong young lightning-wielding planeswalker, Will's twin sister, who opens the way to Arcavios and leaps into a student duel.

entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: A red-haired woman with a crooked staff and a white owl who invites the Kenrith twins to Strixhaven and sees through her owls' eyes.

entities.name: Shaile Talonrook
entities.description: An owlin dean of Strixhaven who interrupts Liliana after the masked intruder vanishes.

entities.name: Nassari
entities.description: An efreet dean of Strixhaven who wants to lengthen Mage Tower season and downplays the Oriq rumors.

entities.name: Lisette
entities.description: A dean of Strixhaven who commands vines and roots to break up duels.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A beast-bonded man from Ikoria captured on Arcavios by masked mages and brought before a masked man.

entities.name: Mila
entities.description: Lukka's foxlike companion bonded with him through a link.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: A secret society of masked mages obsessed with forbidden magic and power.

entities.name: Masked man
entities.description: A tall, thin man in a bird-like mask wreathed in dark energy who greets Lukka in a cave of shell-backed creatures and offers him a deal.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: A university on Arcavios with five colleges.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane where Strixhaven stands.

entities.name: Biblioplex
entities.description: Strixhaven's vast library holding knowledge of magic from countless worlds.

entities.name: Kylem
entities.description: The Kenrith twins' home where Will prepared to leave.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The plane of the Kenrith twins' home castles.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: Lukka's home plane with crawling nightmares under its cave systems.

entities.name: Prismari
entities.description: The college of students in red and blue, who duel the Silverquills.

entities.name: Silverquill
entities.description: The college of students in black and white who conjure ink spells.

entities.name: Witherbloom
entities.description: A college whose uniform Liliana once wore.

entities.name: Garruk
entities.description: Left the twins to their own security shortly before the invitation arrived.

entities.name: Mavinda Sharpbeak
entities.description: An owlin who will help the twins get settled.

entities.name: Alibou
entities.description: A golem who serves as the school's defense and bears a grudge against Nassari.

events.summary: Liliana, teaching as Professor Onyx, walks the Biblioplex unrecognized by the other professors.
events.quote: the other professors of Strixhaven hadn't recognized Liliana Vess when she introduced herself by an entirely different name

events.summary: Liliana catches a masked intruder stealing books, who strikes her arm with a sickening spell.
events.quote: The words fell away as a streak of purplish light flew from the figure's hand.

events.summary: Liliana identifies the intruder as one of the Oriq, who warns her that her days are numbered.
events.quote: Then you know that your days are numbered.

events.summary: Dean Talonrook interrupts, and the intruder vanishes.
events.quote: When she turned back, the intruder was gone.

events.summary: Will, unable to choose which books to bring, prepares to leave Kylem for Strixhaven.
events.quote: Will Kenrith stared helplessly at the towering stack of books on his bed.

events.summary: Will recalls that Kasmina's invitation came soon after Garruk left them on their own.
events.quote: her invitation had come out of nowhere, arriving only a few days after Garruk had been satisfied enough in their security to leave them on their own

events.summary: Rowan opens a portal and steps through, and Will is pulled after her.
events.quote: Rowan grinned and waved as she stepped into the light and disappeared.

events.summary: The twins arrive on Arcavios where Kasmina and her owl greet them.
events.quote: I see you've both made it.

events.summary: They pass a huge silver torch on the road to the school.
events.quote: The silver column rose high above the trees, piercing the brilliant blue sky.

events.summary: Kasmina welcomes them to Strixhaven as they crest a ridge over the campus.
events.quote: Welcome to Strixhaven.

events.summary: Kasmina leaves them at the gates, telling them to find Mavinda Sharpbeak.
events.quote: Look for an owlin called Mavinda Sharpbeak.

events.summary: The twins find Prismari and Silverquill students dueling in a courtyard.
events.quote: two groups of students flung spells across a grassy field

events.summary: Rowan zaps a Silverquill student preparing an ink spell to protect a Prismari student.
events.quote: She sent a jolt of electricity at the one preparing the ink spell.

events.summary: A coil of living ink sweeps Rowan's feet from under her.
events.quote: a coil of living ink swept her feet out from under her

events.summary: Will's ruined Memoirs of Thadus pushes him to join the fight alongside Rowan.
events.quote: Maybe it is our fight.

events.summary: Will and Rowan combine ice and lightning, but the spells fail to blend smoothly.
events.quote: Something wasn't right.

events.summary: Liliana tells Deans Lisette and Nassari she saw a masked stranger, but they dismiss the rumors.
events.quote: I saw a stranger in a mask on campus.

events.summary: The deans break up the duel, binding the students.
events.quote: Nassari sent a wide swath of water through the crowd, corralling Prismari students.

events.summary: Liliana notices the twins mention Kylem and wonders if they are planeswalkers who could be useful.
events.quote: They probably weren't Oriq agents.

events.summary: In their dorm, Will says their combined magic failed and wonders whether the plane affects it.
events.quote: it should have been smoother. More cohesive.

events.summary: Rowan leaves to live her own life, and Will resolves to find answers alone.
events.quote: We may be twins, but I'm allowed to live my own life.

events.summary: Kasmina watches the twins through her owl's eyes.
events.quote: She could still see the twins in her mind, their images a bit warped from the shape of those avian eyes.

events.summary: Masked Oriq mages ambush Lukka and Mila in a desert and take Lukka prisoner.
events.quote: Slowly, he raised his hands in surrender.

events.summary: In the cave Lukka senses shelled creatures hanging around them.
events.quote: Slowly, whatever it was seemed to unfold, stretching long and spindly legs into the darkness.

events.summary: A masked man greets Lukka by name and offers to teach him in exchange for favors.
events.quote: Welcome to Arcavios, Lukka of Ikoria.

relations.quote: We may be twins, but I'm allowed to live my own life.
Then you know that your days are numbered.

relations.note: Bonded companions linked to each other.
relations.quote: Silently, he reached out through their link to soothe her.

relations.note: She invited the twins and guided them to Strixhaven.
relations.quote: her invitation had come out of nowhere
